de: „Muss man morgens gießen, um länger zu leben?“ ... en: “Do you need to water in the morning to live longer?”... This is because it has become common for leaves to droop or for the soil to dry out quickly. However, I am hesitant to water at any time. Gardening experts advise that the best time to water plants is early in the morning. The ideal time is between 6 a.m. and 10 a.m. in spring and summer.

Id est, quia commune factum est foliis defluere, vel pro solo cito arescere. tamen aliquando rigare incertus sum. Periti hortulani monent ut herbae aquaticae optime mane maneant. Tempus optimum est inter 6 a.m. et 10 a.m., vere et aestate.

Celeritas plus duplo velocior fuit quam temperamentum globalis mediocris maris, curas suscitans circa eventum typhonis superantis in paeninsula Coreanica. Corea Institutum Scientiae Oceani et Technologiae (KIOST) die 12 annuntiavit quod Jinyong Jeong quadrigis investigationis, caput Datae et Divisio infrastructure Oceani, "dataset (collectio notitiarum) aedificaverat" ex observationibus marinis et meteorologicis ex Ieodo Oceani Scientiae Stationis (Ieodo Base) per viginti annos congesta aedificaverat. de:
Ein Tag im Leben eines französischen Lieferfahrers ... Ich verspreche, kein echter Kunde zu sein. Schritt 1. Ich bin ein Fahrradkurier in Paris

„Suleiman“ ist ein Kurier, der Lebensmittel per Fahrrad in der Innenstadt von Paris ausliefert. Das Einschalten der Handy-App und das Warten auf eine Bestellung unterscheidet sich nicht wesentlich von dem koreanischen Fahrern. Man muss immer so in die Pedale treten, als würde man verfolgt. Doch die Dinge laufen nicht wie geplant. Zeit ist Geld, aber Restaurants stehen draußen und verursachen Ärger. Der Streit eskalierte nicht weiter, nachdem Kollegen ihn beruhigt hatten, aber vielleicht, weil er so wütend war, geriet er in einen Verkehrsunfall, das Paket zerknitterte und die Lieferung wurde abgelehnt. Auch wenn die Umstände klar sind, sind die Kunden rücksichtslos…

description:
1단계. 나는 파리의 자전거 택배기사

'술레이만'은 파리 시내에서 음식물을 자전거로 배달하는 택배기사다. 휴대전화 앱을 켜고 주문 기다리는 모습은 한국의 라이더와 별반 다를 게 없다. 항상 쫓기듯 페달을 밟아야 한다. 하지만 계획대로 일은 굴러가지 않는다. 시간이 돈인데 식당은 바깥에 하염없이 세워두고 골탕을 먹인다. 동료들이 달래서 다툼이 더 불거지진 않았지만, 일진 사나워서인지 교통사고도 나고 포장이 구겨져 배송 거부를 당한다. 통사정해도 고객은 매정하다…
en: A day in the life of a French delivery driver... I promise not to be a real customer. Step 1. I am a bicycle courier in Paris. ‘Suleiman’ is a courier who delivers food by bicycle in downtown Paris. Turning on the mobile phone app and waiting for an order is not much different from Korean riders. You always have to pedal as if you are being chased. But things don't go as planned. Time is money, but restaurants are parked outside and causing trouble. The fight did not escalate further after co-workers calmed him down, but perhaps because he was so fierce, he had a traffic accident and the package was crumpled and the delivery was rejected. Even if the circumstances are clear, customers are ruthless…
la: Dies in vita agitator traditionis Gallicae... spondeo non esse realem emptorem. Gradus 1. Ego Lutetiae birota tabellarius sum. 'Suleiman' est tabellarius qui birota in urbe Parisiensi cibum tradit. Conversus in app telephono mobili et ordinem exspectans ab equite Coreana non multum differt. Semper habes pedal quasi persequuntur. Sed res non ex proposito. Tempus est pecunia, sed popinae sunt collocati foris et molesti sunt. Pugnam non ulterius postquam adiutores sedata est, sed fortasse, quia tam ferox erat, negotiatio casus habuit et sarcina intrita et traditio repudiata est. Etiam si res clarae sunt, clientes immites sunt…

de: Ein Herz, das nicht fließen kann, warum sind wir in unserem eigenen Strom versunken? Ich habe Angst vor Wasser. Es muss im Sommer gewesen sein, als ich sieben Jahre alt war, und ich verlor fast den Atem, als ich im Kindergartenschwimmbecken in den tiefen Boden versank, den meine Füße nicht erreichen konnten. Das gedämpfte Geräusch des Wassers, das den Raum erfüllte, und die kurze, ferne Angst, die meinen Körper nach unten zog, je mehr ich mich wehrte, prägten sich wie ein unauslöschliches Zeichen in mein Gedächtnis ein. Seit diesem Tag sind bereits 22 Jahre vergangen, seit ich weiterhin in einem unbequemen Zusammenleben mit einem Wesen namens Wasser lebte. 22 Jahre lang verlor ich in dem starken Duschstrahl, der mich jeden Morgen begrüßte, oder im unerwarteten strömenden Regen für einen Moment den Atem ...

description: 나는 물이 무섭다. 일곱 살의 여름이었나, 유치원 수영장에서 발이 닿지 않는 깊은 바닥으로 가라앉으며 숨이 끊어질 뻔한 적이 있다. 사방을 가득 채우던 먹먹한 물소리, 허우적거릴수록 몸을 아래로 끌어당기던 그 짧고도 아득했던 공포는 지워지지 않는 낙인처럼 뇌리에 각인됐다. 그날 이후 물이라는 존재와 불편한 동거를 이어온 지도 어느덧 22년이다. 22년 동안 매일 아침 맞이하는 샤워기의 거센 물줄기에서, 혹은 불시에 쏟아지는 장대비 속에서, 나는 순간적으로 숨이…
en: A heart that cannot flow, why are we submerged in our own torrent? I am afraid of water. It must have been the summer when I was seven years old, and I almost lost my breath after sinking into the deep bottom where my feet could not reach in the kindergarten swimming pool. The muffled sound of water that filled the room, and the brief, distant fear that pulled my body downward the more I struggled, were engraved in my mind like an indelible brand. Since that day, it has already been 22 years since I continued to live in an uncomfortable cohabitation with a being called water. For 22 years, in the strong stream of shower water that greeted me every morning, or in the unexpected pouring rain, I momentarily lost my breath...
la: Cor quod fluere non potest, cur nostro torrente mergimur? aquae timeo. Aestas necesse fuit, cum septem annos natus essem, et paene spiritum amisi in profundo mersa, ubi pedes mei in lacus kindergarten attingere non poterant. Sonus aquarum obvolutus, qui thalamum implevit, et breves, et longinqui metus, qui corpus meum deorsum trahebant, quo magis luctabam, insculpta erant animo meo quasi torris indelebilis. Ex eo die, iam fuit 22 annorum ex quo incommoditate cohabitationis cum aqua vocata vivere pergo. Per 22 annos, in vehementi aquae pluviae quae me salutavit omni mane vel in insperato imbre effundente, subito spiritum perdidi.

de: Auf dem Weg zur Trauerfeier über den See, Erinnerungen an diesen Tag. Das Gebiet unter dem Sirubawi-Felsen in Hakam-ri, Unam-myeon, Imsil, flussaufwärts des Seomjingang-Flusses, ist seit der Antike ein berühmter Angelplatz. Mitte Juni erinnerten sich die Anwohner an die frühsommerliche Landschaft des Flusses, der vor dem Bau des Staudamms vor Jahrzehnten auf natürliche Weise floss. Unter der Leitung von Lee Jun-hwan (81), dem ehemaligen Leiter des Flussdorfes Hakam-ri, besuchte der Reporter mehrere Dörfer im überfluteten Bereich des Seomjingang-Staudamms und wanderte über Waldstraßen und Bergpfade, um Geschichte und Kultur zu erkunden. Vor dem Bau des Seomjin-Flussdamms befand sich der Unam-Fluss in dieser Gegend, der Oberlauf des Seomjingang-Flusses, nahe genug an dem Dorf auf der anderen Seite des Flusses, sodass es nicht schwierig war, dorthin zu gelangen. …

섬진강댐이 조성되기 이전 시기, 섬진강 상류인 이 지역 운암강은 강 건너 마을과 왕래가 어렵지 않은 가까운 거리였다. …
en: On the way to the memorial service across the lake, memories of that day. The area under Sirubawi Rock in Hakam-ri, Unam-myeon, Imsil, upstream of the Seomjingang River, has been a famous fishing spot since ancient times. In mid-June, residents remembered the early summer scenery of the river flowing naturally before the construction of the dam decades ago. Under the guidance of Lee Jun-hwan (age 81), the former head of the riverside village of Hakam-ri, the reporter visited several villages in the submerged area of ​​the Seomjingang Dam and walked along forest roads and mountain paths to explore history and culture. Before the construction of the Seomjin River Dam, the Unam River in this area, the upper stream of the Seomjingang River, was close enough to the village across the river that it was not difficult to travel there. …
la: In via ad memoriam muneris trans stagnum, memoriam illius diei. Area sub Petra Sirubawi in Hakam-ri, Unam-myeon, Imsil, fluminis Seomjingang, ab antiquis temporibus celeberrima fuit. In medio Iunio, incolarum meminerat scaenarum aestatis primae fluminis fluentis naturaliter ante constructionem matris decenniis. Sub duce Lee Iun-hwan (aetatis 81), caput pristinus pagi fluminis Hakam-ri, notarius complures villas in regione Seomjingang Dam demersas visitavit et per vias silvas et itinera montana ambulavit ad explorandum historiam et culturam. Ante constructionem fluminis Dam Seomjin, flumen Unam in hac provincia, superior rivus Seomjingang, satis erat vicinum trans flumen quod non difficile iter erat. ...

en:
Seonghwan Kim, “We will create a sustainable Seomjin River where nature and people coexist.” "The Seomjin River is the fourth longest river in Korea and has the best health of the aquatic ecosystem among the five major rivers. de: Der Grund, warum sich diese Leute jeden Samstag am Jiri-Berg versammeln. Ich denke über viele Dinge nach, während ich den Jirisan-Pfad entlanggehe, der seit vier Monaten andauert. Wie ist die Straße entstanden und was bedeutet sie? Ich frage mich auch, welche Art von Beziehung es zum Leben hat. War die Straße, die am Anfang geschaffen wurde, lediglich ein Weg zum Überleben der Menschheit, hat sie meiner Meinung nach heute eine größere Bedeutung als Kommunikationsmittel. Über die Bewegung durch den physischen Raum hinaus kann es auch in einem weiteren Sinne interpretiert werden, um den Prozess des Lebens auszudrücken. Auf der Straße zu gehen bedeutet, am Leben zu sein, ein Beweis dafür, dass man noch gesund ist ...
title: 매주 토요일, 이 사람들이 지리산으로 모이는 이유
description: 넉 달 째 이어지는 지리산 둘레길을 걸으면서 많은 것을 생각한다. 길은 어떻게 생겨났으며, 어떤 의미를 함축하고 있는 것일까. 또 삶과는 어떤 연관 관계를 맺고 있는 것인지도 궁금해진다. 태초에 생겨난 길이 단순히 인간의 생존을 위한 길이었다면, 지금은 소통과 수단으로서 의미가 더 있지 않을까 싶다. 물리적 공간을 이동하는 것을 넘어서, 인생의 과정을 표현하는 넓은 의미로도 해석이 가능할 것이다. 길을 걷는다는 것은 살아 있음을 의미하며, 아직도 건강하다는 증…
en: The reason why these people gather at Jiri Mountain every Saturday. I think about many things as I walk along the Jirisan trail, which has been going on for four months. How did the road come into existence, and what does it mean? I also wonder what kind of relationship it has with life. If the road that was created in the beginning was simply a way for human survival, I think it now has more meaning as a means of communication. Beyond moving through physical space, it can also be interpreted in a broader sense to express the process of life. Walking on the road means being alive, proof that you are still healthy...
la: Quam ob rem hi homines omni die Sabbati ad Montem Jiri congregant. Multa cogito de ambulando per vestigia Jirisan, quae per quattuor menses geritur. Quomodo via existit, et quid significat? Miror etiam qualem necessitudinem cum vita habeat. Si via, quae in principio creata est, simpliciter via ad salutem humanam pertinebat, puto nunc maiorem significationem habere pro instrumento communicationis. Praeter spatium physicum movens, etiam latius interpretari potest ut processum vitae exprimat. Ambulans in via significat vivere, probans te esse adhuc sanum...

de:
Es wurde eine Warnung vor einer schweren Hitzewelle herausgegeben, und allein lebende ältere Menschen werden zweimal täglich gefragt, wie es ihnen geht. Da die Hitzewellen im Sommer aufgrund der Klimakrise von Jahr zu Jahr schlimmer werden, hat die Regierung besondere Maßnahmen zum Schutz gefährdeter Gruppen wie allein lebende Senioren, Bewohner von Kleinwohnungen und Obdachlose eingeführt. Insbesondere mit der ab diesem Jahr neu eingeführten „Warnung vor starker Hitzewelle“ wird das Schutzsystem weiter gestärkt, indem die Sicherheit allein lebender älterer Menschen zweimal täglich überprüft wird.

Am 3. kündigte das Ministerium für Gesundheit und Soziales an, dass es die gemeinsam mit zuständigen Ministerien ausgearbeiteten „Sommerschutzmaßnahmen 2026 für gefährdete Bevölkerungsgruppen“ fördern werde. Diese Maßnahme konzentriert sich auf den Schutz derjenigen, die durch Sommerkatastrophen wie Hitzewellen und sintflutartige Regenfälle gefährdet sind.

A severe heat wave warning has been issued, and elderly people living alone are asked how they are doing twice a day. As summer heat waves become more severe every year due to the climate crisis, the government has introduced special measures to protect vulnerable groups such as seniors living alone, residents of small-scale housing, and the homeless. In particular, when the newly established 'severe heat wave warning' is issued starting this year, the protection system will be further strengthened by checking the safety of elderly people living alone twice a day.

On-site criticism of the ‘lukewarm response’ Acting Venezuelan President Czar Delci Rodriguez visits and tours the damaged site in Venezuela's La Guaira state on the 25th (local time). UPI Yonhap News After the earthquake in Venezuela, the system of interim President Delcy Rodriguez (pictured) was put to the test. Former Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro is in close contact with the United States after being extradited to the United States...
la: [Venezuela Gangjin] "Regimen suum officium non facit" et ratio provisoria praesidis Rodríguez commovetur. Quamquam Americae subsidia et cooperationes inculcata sunt. UPI Yonhap Nuntii Post terrae motum in Venezuela, systema praesidis interim Delcy Rodriguez (pictum) probata est. Praeses Venezuelan Nicolas Maduro pristinus arcte coniungitur cum Civitatibus Foederatis Americae post extraditam in Civitates Foederatas...

de: „Machado drängt auf Rückkehr nach Venezuela“... Ist die Katastrophe eine neue Variable in der politischen Situation? Die venezolanische Interimspräsidentin Delcy Rodriguez (rechts) und die venezolanische Oppositionsführerin Maria Corina Machado (links). AFP Yonhap News Die venezolanische Oppositionsführerin Maria Corina Machado, die sich im Ausland aufhält, kündigte ihre Absicht an, in ihr durch das Erdbeben beschädigtes Heimatland zurückzukehren. In einer Zeit, in der die Katastrophenreaktionsfähigkeiten der Übergangsregierung von Delcy Rodriguez auf der Kippe stehen, wird erwartet, dass Machados Rückkehr eine Variable in der politischen Situation Venezuelas sein wird.
title: “마차도, 베네수 귀국 추진”···재난 정국 새 변수되나
description: 델시 로드리게스 베네수엘라 임시 대통령(오른쪽)과 베네수엘라 야권 지도자인 마리아 코리나 마차도(왼쪽). AFP연합뉴스국외 체류 중인 베네수엘라 야권 지도자 마리아 코리나 마차도가 지진 피해를 본 본국으로 돌아가겠다는 뜻을 밝혔다. 델시 로드리게스 임시 정부의 재난 대응 역량이 도마 위에 오른 상황에서 마차도의 귀국은 베네수엘라 정국에 변수가 될 것으로 보···
en: “Machado pushes to return to Venezuela”... Is disaster a new variable in the political situation? Venezuelan interim President Delcy Rodriguez (right) and Venezuelan opposition leader Maria Corina Machado (left). AFP Yonhap News Venezuelan opposition leader Maria Corina Machado, who is staying abroad, announced her intention to return to her home country, which was damaged by the earthquake. At a time when the disaster response capabilities of Delcy Rodriguez's interim government are on the chopping block, Machado's return is expected to be a variable in the Venezuelan political situation.
la: "Machado reverti in Venezuelam urget"... Nova calamitas variabilis est in statu politico? Venezuelan interim praesidens Delcy Rodriguez et Venezuelan oppositio ducis Maria Corina Machado (reliquit). AFP Yonhap Nuntii Venezuelan oppositio ducis Maria Corina Machado, quae peregre moratur, nuntiavit propositum redire in patriam suam, quae terrae motu laesa est. In tempore cum calamitate responsionis facultates regimen interim Delcy Rodriguez in interclusione saepti sunt, reditus Machado variabilis in condicione politica Venezuelan expectatur.

de: Die Störungszone ist im „flachen Epizentrum“ horizontal verschoben … „Erschütterung“ lauter. Auch die Schäden an erdbebengefährdeten Gebäuden nehmen zu. Der U.S. Geological Survey gibt eine „Rote Warnung“ aus. Der erhöhte Schaden durch das starke Erdbeben, das Venezuela am 24. (Ortszeit) erschütterte, wird als Ergebnis einer geringen Tiefe des Epizentrums, „Zwillingsbeben“, die weniger als eine Minute voneinander entfernt auftraten, und einer gefährdeten Gebäudeumgebung analysiert. Laut CNBC verschieben sich an der Nordküste Venezuelas, wo sich das Erdbeben ereignete, die südamerikanische und die karibische Platte jedes Jahr um etwa 2 cm nach Osten.
title: ‘얕은 진원’서 단층대 수평으로 어긋나…더 크게 ‘흔들’
description: 지진 취약한 건축물도 피해 키워미국지질조사국 ‘적색경보’ 발령24일(현지시간) 베네수엘라를 덮친 강진의 피해가 커진 것은 얕은 진원 깊이와 1분도 채 되지 않는 간격으로 발생한 ‘쌍둥이 지진’, 그리고 취약한 건축 환경이 겹친 결과로 분석된다.CNBC에 따르면 지진이 발생한 베네수엘라 북부 연안은 남미판과 카리브판이 매년 약 2㎝씩 동쪽으로 서로 어긋나며 ···
en: The fault zone is shifted horizontally at the ‘shallow epicenter’… ‘Shake’ louder. Damage to earthquake-vulnerable buildings also increases. The U.S. Geological Survey issues a 'red alert'. The increased damage from the strong earthquake that hit Venezuela on the 24th (local time) is analyzed as the result of a shallow epicenter depth, 'twin earthquakes' that occurred less than a minute apart, and a vulnerable building environment. According to CNBC, on the northern coast of Venezuela, where the earthquake occurred, the South American and Caribbean plates are offset to the east by about 2 cm each year.
la: Zona culpae horizontaliter in "vadum epicenter" movetur. "maiores excutite". Damnum terrae motui-vulnerabilium aedificiorum etiam augetur, US Geological Survey quaestiones 'Red Alert' Increvit damnum ex vehementi terrae motu qui Venezuelam die 24 (loci temporis) evolvit propter altitudinem altitudinis tenuioris, 'terrae motus gemini' qui minus quam minutam interiit, et ambitus vulnerabilis aedificatio facta est. Secundum CNBC, litus Americae septentrionalis Venetiolae, ubi terrae motus fiebat, est ubi bracteae Americanae Meridionalis et Caribbeae ad orientem per 2 cm fere quotannis cinguntur.

de: IWF und Weltbank helfen Venezuela, sich vom Erdbeben zu erholen... erste Unterstützung seit der Normalisierung der Beziehungen. Am 25. (Ortszeit) wird in Caracas, der Hauptstadt Venezuelas, nach Opfern gesucht, die unter den Trümmern eines Gebäudes eingeschlossen sind. AFP Yonhap News Der Internationale Währungsfonds (IWF) und die Weltbank unterstützen Venezuela, das durch eine Reihe starker Erdbeben erhebliche Schäden erlitten hat. Seit der Wiederaufnahme der seit etwa 20 Jahren unterbrochenen Zusammenarbeit mit Venezuela sind rund drei Monate vergangen. Laut Bloomberg News beschrieb IWF-Sprecherin Julie Kozak am 25. (Ortszeit) die Lage vor Ort.
title: IMF·세계은행, 베네수엘라 지진 복구 돕는다···관계 정상화 이후 첫 지원
description: 베네수엘라 수도 카라카스에서 25일(현지시간) 건물 잔해에 깔린 희생자 수색 작업이 이뤄지고 있다. AFP연합뉴스국제통화기금(IMF)과 세계은행이 연쇄 강진으로 막대한 피해가 발생한 베네수엘라 지원에 나선다. 약 20년간 끊겼던 베네수엘라와의 협력을 재개한 지 약 3개월 만이다.블룸버그통신에 따르면 줄리 코작 IMF 대변인은 25일(현지시간) 현지 상황을 ···
en: IMF and World Bank help Venezuela recover from earthquake... first support since normalization of relations. A search for victims trapped under the rubble of a building is underway in Caracas, the capital of Venezuela, on the 25th (local time). AFP Yonhap News The International Monetary Fund (IMF) and the World Bank are providing support to Venezuela, which has suffered extensive damage from a series of strong earthquakes. It has been about three months since the resumption of cooperation with Venezuela, which had been cut off for about 20 years. According to Bloomberg News, IMF spokeswoman Julie Kozak described the local situation on the 25th (local time).
la: IMF et Argentaria Mundi auxilium Venezuela a terrae motu recuperant... primum subsidium ab ordinatione relationum. Investigatio victimarum sub ruderibus aedificii deprehensus est citatus in Caracas, in urbe Venezuela, die 25 (loci temporis). AFP Yonhap Nuntii Fundus Monetarius Internationalis (IMF) et Argentaria Mundus Venezuelam sustentant, quod magnum damnum ex serie terrae motuum vehementiorum passa est. Circiter tres menses a resumptione cooperationis cum Venetiola facta est, quae circiter XX annos interclusa erat. Secundum Bloomberg News, IMF loquens mulier Julie Kozak condicionem localem die XXV (loci temporis).

de:
50.000 Menschen werden bei Erdbeben in Venezuela vermisst... Es bleiben nur noch 72 goldene Stunden für die Rettung. (Seoul = Yonhap News) Reporter Kwak Min-seo = Am 26. (Ortszeit), drei Tage nach der schlimmsten Erdbebenserie in Venezuela seit 126 Jahren, geht die „goldene 72-Stunden-Zeit“ für die Rettung vermisster Menschen zu Ende.

Da es an staatlicher Unterstützung und Rettungsausrüstung mangelt, kämpfen die Bewohner des Bundesstaates La Guaira, wo die Erdbebenschäden am stärksten waren, mit bloßen Händen, um so viele Menschen wie möglich zu retten.

Laut Associated Press wurden durch die Erdbebenserie in Venezuela mindestens 920 Menschen getötet, mehr als 51.000 Menschen wurden vermisst.
title: 베네수엘라 지진 실종자 5만명인데…구조 골든타임 72시간 얼마 안 남아
description:
(서울=연합뉴스) 곽민서 기자 = 베네수엘라에 126년 만에 최악의 연쇄 강진이 발생한 지 사흘째인 26일(현지시간) 실종자 구조를 위한 '72시간 골든타임'이 끝나가고 있다.

정부 지원과 구조 장비가 턱없이 부족한 가운데 지진 피해가 집중된 라과이라주(主) 주민들은 한 명이라도 많은 사람을 구조하기 위해 맨손으로 사투를 벌이고 있다.

AP통신에 따르면 베네수엘라 연쇄 강진에 따른 사망자는 이날까지 최소 920명으로 집계됐으며, 실종자는 5만1천명 이상에 …
en:
50,000 people missing in Venezuela earthquake... There are only 72 golden hours left for rescue. (Seoul = Yonhap News) Reporter Kwak Min-seo = On the 26th (local time), three days after the worst series of earthquakes in Venezuela in 126 years, the '72-hour golden time' for rescuing missing people is coming to an end.

With government support and rescue equipment severely lacking, residents of the state of La Guaira, where the earthquake damage was concentrated, are fighting with their bare hands to rescue as many people as possible.

According to the Associated Press, the death toll due to the series of earthquakes in Venezuela was counted as at least 920 people, and more than 51,000 people were missing.
la:
50.000 hominum in Venezuela terrae motu carentes ... Solae 72 horae aureae ad liberandum relictae sunt. (Seoul = Yonhap News) Reporter Kwak Min-seo = On the 26th (local time), three days after the worst series of earthquakes in Venezuela in 126 years, the '72-hour golden time' for rescuing missing people is coming to an end.

According to the Associated Press, the death toll due to the series of earthquakes in Venezuela was counted as at least 920 people, and more than 51,000 people were missing.

de: Heathrow-Gatwick-Flug 900 wegen Sturm verspätet... Das Luftfahrtkorps macht weiter. [ZD Net Korea] Mehr als 900 Flüge hatten aufgrund des Sturms am Flughafen London Heathrow und am Flughafen Gatwick in Großbritannien Verspätung. Einige Flüge hatten eine Verspätung von bis zu 11 Stunden und Dutzende Flüge wurden annulliert. Laut einem BBC-Bericht vom 28. (Ortszeit) kündigte die britische Flugsicherungsbehörde (NATS) an, dass Flugzeuge aufgrund des schlechten Wetters Sturmgebiete meiden sollten und der Abstand zwischen Flugzeugen aus Sicherheitsgründen größer als üblich sein sollte. en: Heathrow-Gatwick flight 900 delayed due to storm... The aviation corps continues. [ZD Net Korea] More than 900 flights were delayed due to the storm at London Heathrow Airport and Gatwick Airport in the UK. Some flights were delayed by up to 11 hours, and dozens of flights were canceled. According to a BBC report on the 28th (local time), the British air traffic control agency (NATS) announced that due to bad weather, aircraft should avoid storm areas and that the distance between aircraft should be wider than usual for safety. Because of this, it was expected that flight operations would be disrupted for the remainder of Saturday and overnight. Between flight tracking…
la: Fuga 900 Heathrow-Gatwick propter expugnationem morata est. [ZD Net Korea] Plus quam 900 volatus tempestate Londinii moratus est Heathrow Airport et Gatwick Airport in UK. Quidam volatus ab usque ad 11 horas morati sunt, et justo volatus instat. Secundum relationem BBC die XXVIII (loci temporis), Britanniae aëris commercii intermedium imperium (NATS) denuntiavit ob tempestatibus, aircraft tempestatum vitare debere, et intervallum inter aircraft latius solito ad salutem esse debere. Propter hoc exspectabatur quod operationes fugae propter sabbati et pernoctare residua dissiparentur. Inter fugam tracking…

de: Eumseong-gun, Provinz Nord-Chungcheong, persönliches Evakuierungsunterstützungspersonal für katastrophengefährdete Gruppen. Eumseong-gun, Provinz Nord-Chungcheong, kündigte am 8. an, dass es zur Vorbereitung auf Sommerkatastrophen Maßnahmen zur umfassenden Unterstützung für katastrophengefährdete Gruppen wie ältere Menschen mit eingeschränkter Mobilität und Behinderte umsetzen wird. Hierbei handelt es sich um eine Methode zum Schutz gefährdeter Haushalte, die im Katastrophenfall Schwierigkeiten haben, alleine zu evakuieren, indem eine „persönliche Person zur Evakuierungsunterstützung“ benannt wird. In Eumseong-gun sind 39 Orte, darunter in der Nähe von Flüssen, Tälern und erdrutschgefährdeten Gebieten, als katastrophengefährdete Gebiete ausgewiesen. Unter den Bewohnern dieser Gegend...
title: 충북 음성군, 재난 취약계층 1 대 1 대피지원 담당자 운영
description: 충북 음성군이 여름 재난·재해에 대비해 거동이 불편한 고령자와 장애인 등 재난 취약계층 밀착 지원 대책을 가동한다고 8일 밝혔다. 재난 상황 발생 시 스스로 대피가 어려운 취약계층 가구에 ‘1대1 대피지원 담당자’를 지정해 보호하는 방식이다.음성군에는 하천 인근이나 계곡, 산사태 우려 지역 등 39곳이 재난 취약지역으로 지정돼 있다. 이 지역 거주자 중 재···
en: Eumseong-gun, North Chungcheong Province, one-on-one evacuation support staff for disaster-vulnerable groups. Eumseong-gun, North Chungcheong Province, announced on the 8th that it will implement close support measures for disaster-vulnerable groups such as elderly people with limited mobility and the disabled in preparation for summer disasters. This is a method of protecting vulnerable households who have difficulty evacuating on their own in the event of a disaster by designating a ‘one-to-one evacuation support person’. In Eumseong-gun, 39 places, including near rivers, valleys, and areas at risk of landslides, are designated as disaster-vulnerable areas. Among residents of this area...
la: Eumseong-gun, Provincia Chungcheong Septentrionalis, unum in una evacuatione virgam sustinent coetus vulnerabiles calamitatis. Eumseong-gun, Provincia Septentrionalis Chungcheong, die VIII denuntiavit se subsidia arctissima subsidia pro societatibus calamitatibus vulnerabilibus efficiendum, sicut senes homines cum motu limitata et debiles in praeparatione ad calamitates aestivas. Haec est methodus tutandi familias vulnerabiles, quae difficultatem habent propriae evacuationis in casu calamitatis, designando 'unam evacuationem sustinendi personam'. In Eumseong-gun, 39 loca, inter fluvios, valles, ac loca in periculo ruinarum, designantur ut plagae vulnerabiles. In quis vestibulum elit.

de: Die Fläche der Stadt hat sich in 30 Jahren verdoppelt, landwirtschaftliche Flächen und Feuchtgebiete sind zurückgegangen und der Druck auf das Ökosystem hat zugenommen. An einem Tag mit Frühlingsregen im ganzen Land machen Bürger mit Regenschirmen einen Spaziergang durch den Waldweg des Incheon Grand Park. Leitender Reporter Kim Jeong-geun Während sich die Fläche inländischer Städte in den letzten 30 Jahren fast verdoppelt hat, sind landwirtschaftliche Flächen und Feuchtgebiete deutlich zurückgegangen. Es wurde analysiert, dass die Urbanisierung und die Klimakrise das heimische Ökosystem insgesamt verschlechtert haben, da auch die Gefahr extremer Regenfälle, Waldbrände und Erdrutsche zugenommen hat. Das Ministerium für Klima, Energie und Umwelt prognostiziert Veränderungen im koreanischen Ökosystem.
title: 도시 면적 30년 새 2배로···농경지·습지는 줄고 생태계 압력 커졌다
description: 전국적으로 봄비가 내린 날 우산을 쓴 시민들이 인천대공원 숲길을 산책하고 있다. 김정근 선임기자지난 30년간 국내 도시 면적이 두 배 가까이 늘어나는 동안 농경지와 습지는 크게 줄어든 것으로 나타났다. 극한호우와 산불, 산사태 위험도 함께 커지면서 도시화와 기후위기가 국내 생태계를 전반적으로 악화시킨 것으로 분석됐다.기후에너지환경부는 한국 생태계의 변화 추···
en: The area of ​​the city has doubled in 30 years, agricultural land and wetlands have decreased, and pressure on the ecosystem has increased. On a day of spring rain across the country, citizens wearing umbrellas are taking a walk through the forest path of Incheon Grand Park. Senior Reporter Kim Jeong-geun While the area of ​​domestic cities has nearly doubled over the past 30 years, agricultural land and wetlands have decreased significantly. It was analyzed that urbanization and the climate crisis have worsened the domestic ecosystem as a whole, as the risk of extreme rainfall, forest fires, and landslides has also increased. The Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment is predicting changes in the Korean ecosystem.
la: Area urbis per XXX annos duplicavit, agriculturae et humidae decreverunt, et pressio oecosystematis crevit. Die vernali per regionem pluviae cives umbellas gerentes per silvam Incheon Grand Park iter deambulant. Senior Notarius Kim Jeong-geun Dum area urbium domesticorum per XXX annos proxime duplicata est, terra agriculturae et humida significanter decreverunt. Perspicuum est urbanizationem et discrimen climatis totam ecosystem domesticam ingravescentem, ut periculum extremae pluviae, incendia silvarum et ruinarum etiam aucta sint. Ministerium Climatis, Energy et Environment mutationes in ecosystem Coreanica praedicunt.

de: [Erdbeben in Venesu] Mehr als 1.700 Menschen starben, UN „sichert 10.000 Leichensäcke“ ... Auch die Überlebenden sind durch Nachbeben und Plünderungen doppelt belastet. Am 29. (Ortszeit) suchen Rettungskräfte in den Trümmern eines durch ein Erdbeben eingestürzten Gebäudes in La Guaira, Venezuela, nach Überlebenden. EPA Yonhap News Während die Rettung von Überlebenden nach dem starken Erdbeben in Venezuela weitergeht, gibt es Prognosen, dass ein weiterer Anstieg der Todesfälle unvermeidlich ist, da die Vereinten Nationen 10.000 Säcke für die Bergung der Leichen sichergestellt haben.
